summary: At a swearing-in the incoming member waits for the person administering the oath to give the words.
realLife: At the start of the 119th House, the Speaker directed the incoming members to stand and lift their right hands. Once they had risen, he put the oath to the whole group as a question.
inGame: swearing-in.ts and data/swearing-in.json carry the oath giver and ceremony.
gates: The seat has an incoming holder at a swearing-in.

turns.what: The incoming member asks the clerk to repeat the last phrase.
turns.pulledBy: Noise from the gallery covered the prompt.
turns.writesBack: The clerk resumes at the missed phrase before recording completion.

turns.what: The district office waits to issue its welcome announcement until the absent member takes the oath at a later sitting.
turns.pulledBy: The member missed the group ceremony and the chamber has recorded a separate swearing-in date.
turns.writesBack: The announcement uses the member’s own oath date.
